evidence.quote: However, the national economic recovery clearly has a long way to go.
the recovery--both at the national level and here in Los Angeles--has been extraordinarily slow compared with other recoveries.
the Federal Reserve remains fully committed to doing everything it can to promote maximum employment in the context of price stability.

The Fed then substantially expanded its holdings of longer-term securities and more recently moved to lengthen the average maturity of its holdings to put downward pressure on longer-term interest rates.
Being unemployed for such a long time can have negative effects on workers' skills and their attachment to the labor force, thereby possibly reducing the productive capacity of our economy.

parsed.rationale: The speech emphasizes a deep, unusually slow recovery, housing drag and long-term unemployment, and defends accommodative policy and asset purchases with a commitment to do everything possible for maximum employment. Inflation is not discussed, and there is no explicit signal of new easing, so the lean is moderately dovish.
